sum: Claros Mortgage Trust, Inc. operates as a commercial real estate (CRE) finance company in the United States. It focuses on originating senior and subordinate loans on transitional CRE assets. The company has elected to be taxed as a real estate investment trust. As a result, it would not be subject to federal income tax on that portion of its income that is distributed to shareholders. Claros Mortgage Trust, Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
ceo: Mr. Richard Jay Mack J.D. (Chairman & CEO)
